verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a vector database, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no object or collection deletion, TTL/expiry, or retention-policy capability. Multi-tenancy isolation, backups, replication, and self-hosting options are related features, not retention or deletion controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
